propositions: Closed bugs lacking close_class must be backfilled by inference from structural signals only: revert of STATUS/COMMITS event signals regression, plan-review BLOCK signals plan_defect, gate_error_v1 ERROR signals env_integration, and absence of all three signals yields undetermined

The backfill must read reverts from reduced state, REVIEW_RESULT BLOCKs via all_review_results, and gate_error_v1 events via raw event-file scan (not schema-guarded all_review_results), to correctly detect each signal
Backfilled records must be written to .rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson with source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified, segregating them from authoritative close_class values
The backfill script must be idempotent: skip any ticket already present in the artifact or already carrying a close_class value, and support --dry-run mode
A revert of a COMMENT or LINK event must not trigger regression classification; only reverts of substantive STATUS or COMMITS events qualify
